title: Blaschka public auction provenance records

scope.purpose: Public auction appearances are retained as provenance evidence and gap-filling market traces, not as a price guide.
scope.include_rule: Include a public auction appearance of an attributed Blaschka model when the checked public sources do not explicitly identify the buyer as a museum, university, or comparable institutional collection.
scope.institutional_buyer_exclusion: If a museum, university, or comparable institutional buyer is explicitly documented, exclude that acquisition from this auction layer and place it in the collection/provenance layer instead.
scope.buyer_unknown_rule: Auction appearance does not prove private ownership. When the buyer is not public, post-sale custody remains open.
scope.tentative_attribution_rule: Qualified auction attributions may be retained only when the qualification is explicit in the record.
scope.price_rule: Preserve the auction platform's own price type. Do not silently convert buyer-premium-inclusive prices to hammer prices or infer a realized price from an estimate.
scope.coverage_claim: This is a targeted deep pass across directly searchable auction-house and aggregator archives. It is not a proof that no additional auction records exist.
